name: Strait Innovation Internet Co., Ltd
summary: Strait Innovation Internet Co., Ltd. provides information technology and intelligent services in China. It offers planning and consulting, platform development, solution design, system integration, project delivery, project management, and operation and maintenance value-added services; financial services and consulting services; network information services; telemedicine services; leasing and business services; and film screening services. The company also undertakes construction projects, such as smart transportation, smart agriculture, smart public security, smart cultural tourism, smart emergency response, smart ocean, smart water management, and big data centers.
